widgets_values: 万物光影融合全能溶图产品打光.safetensors

The subject is locked (the product shape/angle/orientation/texture/details are completely fixed, and rotation/deformation is prohibited), and the scene environment is replaced; the new scene rigidly adapts the perspective around the subject: the contact points are precisely aligned, and the perspective vanishing point is consistent with the subject's perspective; the light and shadow logic is deeply unified: the light source direction/light and dark levels/highlights and shadows are completely matched with the subject, the product reflection is generated according to the scene ground material, and the material reflection conforms to the laws of ambient light; the edges are seamlessly connected at the pixel level, maintaining the original image proportions and composition, eliminating splicing marks, and achieving a physically realistic fusion of product and scene perspective/light and shadow/material mapping
